objective: EXP-001 runs end to end: drafts written by a cheap model, the owner's three real-world steps held as approval cards, the verdict computed by code, and the next experiment drafted from that verdict.
bottleneck: no validated revenue experiment exists yet — nothing has tested whether anyone pays SevaaConnect through this machinery
success: RESULT.md exists in PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/ with SUCCESS or FAILURE, M0 is reached on SUCCESS, and NEXT_EXPERIMENT.md names what runs next.

steps.title: Record EXP-001 as the standing revenue experiment decision
steps.why: The experiment is only real to the system once it is a decision it can cite; this stops a later session re-litigating the offer.
steps.exec_command: ./aion decide "EXP-001 first revenue experiment" "Run EXP-001: paid design consultation at INR 2499 to 30 warm contacts over 14 days; rules in PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/experiment.json" --rationale "Cheapest falsifiable path to M0: no deployment, no ad spend, the payment is recorded by machinery that already exists" --evidence "EXPERIMENT.md committed on the working branch"
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "from aion_core import db; import sys; sys.exit(0 if db.connect().execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM decisions WHERE subject LIKE 'EXP-001 first%'\").fetchone() else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: aion why on the decision id shows the experiment and its rationale

steps.title: Record the success case as a labelled FORECAST, never as revenue
steps.why: The phone shows forecasts under a separate heading; recording the target makes the gap visible without ever touching the real figures.
steps.exec_command: ./aion money-add revenue 7497 --stage FORECAST --description "EXP-001 success case: 3 consults x INR 2499 (FORECAST, not real money)"
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "from aion_core import metrics; import sys; sys.exit(0 if metrics.money()['non_actual'].get('FORECAST') else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: aion money lists the 7497 under 'Not real money'; real revenue stays at 0

steps.title: Draft the one-to-one WhatsApp outreach message (English and Gujarati)
steps.why: The owner must be able to copy-paste one message per contact in under a minute; the wording decides the reply rate.
steps.prompt: Write the file PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md. Read EXPERIMENT.md in the same folder first. Contents, in this order: (1) a heading '# Outreach message — EXP-001'; (2) a section '## English' with ONE WhatsApp message of at most 90 words, written as a personal note from the founder of SevaaConnect (architecture and interior design, Gujarat) to someone they know, offering a 'Design Clarity Call': 90 minutes, a one-page written brief within 48 hours, price INR 2,499 including GST, paid in advance through a payment link, the full fee credited against any SevaaConnect project signed within 90 days; end with one yes/no question, not a pitch; (3) a section '## Gujarati' with the same message in natural Gujarati script, same length; (4) a section '## Rules for sending' with five bullets: send one-to-one only, never a broadcast; personalise the first line with why you thought of them; do not include any link until they say yes, then send the payment link from PAYMENT_LINK.md; log every send in contacts.csv by code the same day; reply to every answer within 24 hours and record reply and reason_code. Constraints: no emojis, no exclamation marks, no claims about past clients, no URLs anywhere in the file, the literal string '2,499' must appear in both language sections, the word 'credited' must appear in the English section. Do not write anything else. After writing, run: grep -q '2,499' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md && grep -qi credited PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md && ! grep -q 'http' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md
steps.validation_command: grep -q '2,499' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md && grep -qi credited PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md && grep -q '## Gujarati' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md && ! grep -q http PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/outreach_message.md
steps.success_criteria: The owner can paste the English or Gujarati block as-is; it names the price, the credit, and ends with a question; it links nowhere

steps.title: Draft the one-page Design Clarity Brief template
steps.why: The paid deliverable must be producible in 45 minutes after the call; a fixed skeleton makes that true and makes every brief comparable.
steps.prompt: Write the file PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md: a one-page Markdown template SevaaConnect fills in after each paid 90-minute consultation. Read EXPERIMENT.md in the same folder first. Sections, in this order, each with a one-line instruction in italics for the person filling it in and 2-4 empty bullet placeholders: '# Design Clarity Brief' with placeholders for client code (C-number only, never a name), date, property type and size; '## What you told us' (the client's goals, constraints, timeline); '## Recommended direction' (one layout or design direction with the reason it fits, and one alternative rejected and why); '## Budget range' (a low and high INR range for the recommended direction, split into design fees, materials and labour, with the assumption behind each); '## Next three steps' (numbered, each with who does it and by when); '## How the INR 2,499 is applied' (one sentence: credited in full against a SevaaConnect project signed within 90 days of the brief date). Constraints: fits on one printed page, no marketing language, no URLs, the headings '## Budget range' and '## Next three steps' must appear exactly. After writing, run: grep -q '## Budget range' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md && grep -q '## Next three steps' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md
steps.validation_command: grep -q '## Budget range' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md && grep -q '## Next three steps' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md && grep -qi credited PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/brief_template.md
steps.success_criteria: An architect can fill the template from call notes in under 45 minutes and the client gets one page they can act on

steps.title: Draft the call checklist that makes the brief write itself
steps.why: Every question the brief needs must be asked on the call; a checklist removes the second call and the owner's memory from the process.
steps.prompt: Write the file PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/call_checklist.md. Read brief_template.md in the same folder first: every section of the brief must be answerable from this checklist. Format: '# Call checklist — Design Clarity Call (90 min)', then five sections with time boxes: '## 0-10 min: context' , '## 10-40 min: the property and the goal', '## 40-65 min: constraints and budget', '## 65-85 min: direction and reactions', '## 85-90 min: close'. Under each section, Markdown checkbox items in the exact form '- [ ] question text' — at least 12 checkboxes in total, each a concrete question the architect asks (for example the property size in square feet, possession date, who decides, rough budget the client has in mind, what they have seen and disliked). The close section must include the checkbox '- [ ] Tell them the brief arrives within 48 hours and how the INR 2,499 is credited'. Constraints: no URLs, no names, nothing about SevaaConnect's past work. After writing, run: python3 -c "import sys;sys.exit(0 if open('PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/call_checklist.md').read().count('- [ ]')>=12 else 1)"
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "import sys;t=open('PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/call_checklist.md').read();sys.exit(0 if t.count('- [ ]')>=12 and '48 hours' in t else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: Twelve or more concrete questions, time-boxed, ending with the 48-hour promise and the credit rule

steps.title: Confirm the funnel log and the experiment reader agree
steps.why: The whole verdict depends on contacts.csv having the exact header the reader expects; check it before the owner types a single row.
steps.validation_command: head -1 PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/contacts.csv | grep -q 'contact_code,sent_at,reply,reason_code,paid,payment_ref' && ./aion experiment EXP-001 | grep -q 'State: NOT_STARTED'
steps.success_criteria: aion experiment EXP-001 prints the funnel with 0 sent and state NOT_STARTED

steps.title: OWNER: create the Razorpay payment link and answer the five unknowns
steps.why: Only the founder can log in to Razorpay and only the founder knows the warm-contact count, prior pricing and who delivers; nothing else in the experiment needs a decision from a human.
steps.success_criteria: PAYMENT_LINK.md (copied from PAYMENT_LINK.template.md) holds the live payment link URL, 'razorpay_live_mode: yes', and the five answers; about 15 minutes of the owner's time

steps.title: OWNER: send the message one-to-one to 30 warm contacts within 3 days and log each by code
steps.why: This is the experiment. The system never sends outbound messages to real people; the owner does, and the log is what the verdict reads.
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "from aion_core import experiments; import sys; sys.exit(0 if experiments.status('EXP-001')['sent']>=30 else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: contacts.csv has 30 or more rows with a sent_at date, codes only; aion experiment EXP-001 shows state RUNNING

steps.title: OWNER: deliver each paid call, record every payment the same day, keep the log current until the window closes
steps.why: Payments become revenue only through aion money-add with the Razorpay payment id; the verdict is computed from those rows, so a payment recorded late is a payment the experiment did not see.
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "from aion_core import experiments; import sys; sys.exit(0 if experiments.status('EXP-001')['decided'] else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: Every payment is an ACTUAL revenue row 'EXP-001 payer Cnn' with evidence razorpay:pay_...; every reply has a reason_code; aion experiment EXP-001 reaches SUCCESS or FAILURE

steps.title: Write the verdict from the rules, not from opinion
steps.why: RESULT.md is produced by the same code the phone reads, so nobody can call the experiment a success by hand.
steps.success_criteria: RESULT.md names SUCCESS or FAILURE, the funnel numbers, and the decision that outcome forces

steps.title: Record the verdict as a decision so the next session starts from it
steps.why: A result that lives only in a file is rediscovered; a decision is cited by aion why and by the next strong session.
steps.exec_command: ./aion decide "EXP-001 result" "$(head -1 PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/RESULT.md)" --rationale "$(sed -n '/## Decision this forces/,$p' PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/RESULT.md | tail -n +2 | head -3)" --evidence "RESULT.md written by aion experiment --decide"
steps.validation_command: python3 -c "from aion_core import db; import sys; sys.exit(0 if db.connect().execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM decisions WHERE subject='EXP-001 result'\").fetchone() else 1)"
steps.success_criteria: aion search 'EXP-001 result' returns the decision

steps.title: Draft the next experiment from the verdict's forced decision
steps.why: The decision tree in experiment.json already says what runs next for each outcome; a cheap model turns that sentence into a full experiment file so the strong session is not needed to continue.
steps.prompt: Read PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/EXP-001-paid-design-consult/RESULT.md, EXPERIMENT.md and experiment.json. The RESULT names the decision this outcome forces (SUCCESS -> EXP-002 consult-to-project stage; FAILURE with price as top reason -> EXP-001b at INR 999; FAILURE otherwise -> EXP-003 different buyer). Create the folder PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/<ID>-<short-name>/ for exactly that next experiment and write two files there: EXPERIMENT.md in the same structure as EXP-001's (offer, buyer, channel, hypothesis stated so it can be false, baseline from RESULT.md, conditions as numbers, unit economics, UNKNOWNs with the cheapest way to learn each, measurement, and the decision each outcome forces) and experiment.json with the same keys as EXP-001's experiment.json (experiment_id, project, title, offer, offer_price_inr, buyer, channel, hypothesis, funnel_log, revenue_description_prefix, min_contacts, min_contacts_deadline_days, window_days, success, failure, ambiguous, cost_ceiling_inr, decisions, unknowns), plus an empty contacts.csv with the header contact_code,sent_at,reply,reason_code,paid,payment_ref. Then write PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/NEXT_EXPERIMENT.md containing one line: the new experiment id, its title and its folder path. Constraints: no names, phone numbers or emails anywhere; every number in EXPERIMENT.md either measured (cite RESULT.md) or marked UNKNOWN with how to learn it; no C-class step is needed to run it. Validate with: python3 -c "import json,glob;[json.load(open(p)) for p in glob.glob('PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/*/experiment.json')]" and ./aion experiments must list the new id.
steps.validation_command: test -s PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/NEXT_EXPERIMENT.md && python3 -c "import json,glob;[json.load(open(p)) for p in glob.glob('PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments/*/experiment.json')]" && ./aion experiments | grep -qE 'EXP-00[1-9][a-z]?: ' && test $(./aion experiments | wc -l) -ge 2
steps.success_criteria: A second experiment folder exists, aion experiments lists it, and NEXT_EXPERIMENT.md points at it

steps.title: Commit the experiment folder so the result survives the machine
steps.why: The shared brain is machine state; the repository is the only durable record of what was learned.
steps.exec_command: git add PROJECTS/sevaa-sales-os/experiments && git commit -q -m "EXP-001: verdict recorded and next experiment drafted" || echo nothing-to-commit
steps.success_criteria: git log shows the EXP-001 commit; the working tree has no unstaged experiment files
